reviews.comment: He's a great guy, deeply devoted to science, with an awful temper. No tests, just one project: build a fancy scientific simulator. It's easy after PETE 640. The course is intense, George is harsh—a real ass—but he won't let you down. Focus on learning, you'll earn an A anyway. I owe him a big part of my career, not a job, but key skills to excel.

Dr. Moridis is tought, there's not sugar cout for him but you'll learn all the secrets of reservoir simulation. People does not fail this class, no one gets less than an A but he'll make you work your ass off. 

Most of the time he appears to be mad but its only his way of life. Also, he'll take the entire class for dinner once or twice.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you want to deal with someone that is going to treat you like a piece of trash, shout at you every class and make you feel like you are the worst student he ever had, you must take this class. He is not going to teach something really significant about the subject you are looking for, just how to handle and modify his not-know simulator.
